verdict.rationale: Real-time multiplayer editing is a fair question for a visual website and design builder like Framer, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents simultaneous editing, live cursors, or instant sync between teammates. The only collaboration-page item (framer-docs-47) describes branches, an asynchronous copy-and-merge workflow, and the 'stay in sync' wording refers to CMS content linking to the canvas, not multiplayer editing.
